WIZARD-LEVEL_SECRET.pages.INITIAL.descri:
You take a side path that [red]does not exist[/red], and find a [purple]room[/purple] that [red]should not exist[/red]. [purple]Everything[/purple] in it looks [purple]long abandoned[/purple].
Either way, you have found some [gold][sine]good stuff[/sine][/gold]!
WIZARD-LEVEL_SECRET.pages.INITIAL.option: Take the one by the door
Take the one in the inner room
WIZARD-LEVEL_SECRET.pages.RESULT.descrip: You leave [gold]laden with loot[/gold]. But was none of this without [red]a price[/red]?
WIZARD-LEVEL_SECRET.title: Level Secret
WIZARD-RULES_HORROR.loss: {character}'s mind was destroyed by the magic of the Rules Horror...
WIZARD-RULES_HORROR.pages.ABUNDANT.descr: The Spire seems to [gold]acknowledge[/gold] your spirit, and you reap [gold]an abundance of treasure[/gold] (?)
WIZARD-RULES_HORROR.pages.BALANCED.descr: You receive a small [gold]blessing[/gold]. Then the notice and the voice both vanish.
WIZARD-RULES_HORROR.pages.INITIAL.descri:
As you wander the [gold]resplendent atrium[/gold], a notice of [purple]rules[/purple] scrawled across the corner wall catches your eye. Some [red]irresistible force[/red] draws you to it.

An [gold]unknown voice[/gold] asks you: [sine]What [purple]principle[/purple] do you hold?[/sine]
WIZARD-RULES_HORROR.pages.INITIAL.option: Requires a deck of more than [blue]35[/blue] cards.
Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. Remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
Requires a deck of fewer than [blue]20[/blue] cards.
WIZARD-RULES_HORROR.pages.LEAN.descripti:
The voice gives a cold laugh and departs without a word.

It seems you have deeply displeased [red]someone[/red]?
WIZARD-RULES_HORROR.pages.LEAVE.descript: You [sine][red]struggle[/red][/sine] free of the [purple]binding magic[/purple] and escape, your heart still racing.
WIZARD-RULES_HORROR.title: Rules Horror
WIZARD-VOLCANO_SAGE.loss: {character} was struck down by the power slumbering within the volcano...
WIZARD-VOLCANO_SAGE.pages.CONSULT.descri:
...Before you can hear his [purple]proverbs[/purple], your mind is swept away by the [gold]heat[/gold]. When you wake, the volcano is nowhere to be found.
“[purple]The truth of all worldly matter...[/purple]” you murmur, and your [red]resolve[/red] toward the [purple]ending[/purple] is renewed.
WIZARD-VOLCANO_SAGE.pages.DEBATE.descrip: ...[gold]“My head aches... where am I?”[/gold] When you wake, you realize the [gold]illusion[/gold] was absurd. Yet that [purple]difficult puzzle[/purple] lingers in your mind.
WIZARD-VOLCANO_SAGE.pages.DEFY.descripti: Your mind is [blue]clear as glass[/blue]. You know now [red]who[/red] he is, and you [red]do not fear[/red] the fight.
WIZARD-VOLCANO_SAGE.pages.INITIAL.descri:
For reasons unknown, you find yourself standing at the mouth of an [gold]active volcano[/gold]!
[red][sine]Seething[/sine][/red] [gold]magma[/gold] roars past; you turn to leave at once.
Yet a [red]figure[/red] takes shape in the [gold]magma[/gold] pool, claiming to hold [purple]the truth of all worldly matter[/purple].
WIZARD-VOLCANO_SAGE.title: Volcano Sage
